# Update team member info

You're already on the team page and something needs to change. For each field you want updated, please check (`[ ] -> [x]`) the corresponding checkbox and add the new information in the appropriate field. **If you want a field removed, check the box but leave the field blank**.

## Fields to update

- [ ] headshot
- [ ] name
- [ ] info
- [ ] notes
- [ ] email
- [ ] linkedin
- [ ] github
- [ ] website
- [ ] scholar
- [ ] researchgate

## Field contents

```yaml
name:
info:
notes:
email:
linkedin:
github:
website:
scholar:
researchgate:
```

## Headshot update

If you want your headshot replaced, attach the new one to this issue by either (i) clicking the attach files button below or (ii) submitting the issue and dragging-and-dropping the image into the comment box.
